pt-BR.overview: An impoverished girl tries to sell matches on New Year's Eve. Shivering with cold and unable to sell her wares, she sits in a sheltered nook. Striking a match to keep warm, the flame shows her what's beyond.

en.title: The Little Match Girl
en.overview: An impoverished girl tries to sell matches on New Year's Eve. Shivering with cold and unable to sell her wares, she sits in a sheltered nook. Striking a match to keep warm, the flame shows her what's beyond.

pt-BR.title: Diferente dos Outros
pt-BR.overview: Conrad Veidt plays a famous musician who is blackmailed for being gay. Eventually he stands trial and is convicted. At the end the film pleads for the abolition of §175 (the law that punishes homosexuality).

en.title: Different from the Others
en.overview: Conrad Veidt plays a famous musician who is blackmailed for being gay. Eventually he stands trial and is convicted. At the end the film pleads for the abolition of §175 (the law that punishes homosexuality).

video.file: Anders als die Andern AKA Different from the Others.mp4

originalTitle: L'Éclipse du soleil en pleine lune

pt-BR.title: Eclipse do Sol com a Lua
pt-BR.overview: Neste filme, Méliès inventa uma combinação de conto de fadas e moralidade sobre a tolice de tentar olhar muito profundamente para o funcionamento de um universo instável e inescrutável. Em uma escola medieval, um velho astrônomo começa a ensinar uma classe de jovens, todos armados com telescópios, sobre a arte de examinar um eclipse iminente. Quando um relógio mecânico bate meia-noite, todos os jovens correm para as janelas e fixam seus telescópios no céu.
pt-BR.tagline: O eclipse do sol na lua cheia

en.title: The Eclipse: Courtship of the Sun and Moon
en.overview: In this film, Méliès concocts a combination fairy- and morality tale about the foolishness of trying to look too deeply into the workings of an unstable and inscrutable universe. At a medieval school, an old astronomer begins to teach a class of young men, all armed with telescopes, about the art of scrutinising an imminent eclipse. When a mechanical clock strikes twelve, all the young men rush to the windows and fix their telescopes on the heavens.

pt-BR.title: Oswald e o Bonde
pt-BR.overview: Oswald, o condutor de bonde, é impedido de passar por uma vaca que se recusa a sair do caminho. Logo depois, ele se depara com uma colina tão íngreme que é impossível de subi-la. Quando Oswald finalmente consegue atravessá-la, ele perde o controle do bonde. Será que seu pé de coelho da sorte conseguirá salvá-lo?

en.title: Trolley Troubles
en.overview: Oswald, the trolley conductor gets stopped in the tracks by a cow who refuses to move. He then faces a steep hill, which the trolley has trouble with. When it finally gets over the hill, the trolley speeds wildly out of control. Can Oswald's lucky rabbit's foot save him?
en.tagline: Can Oswald's lucky rabbit's foot save him from his trolley troubles?

pt-BR.title: Dinamite e Pastel
pt-BR.overview: Pierre e Charles são garçons em um restaurante cujos cozinheiros estão em greve, e que se vêem encrencados quando são obrigados a substituir os grevistas e descobrem que foi colocada dinamite na massa dos pastéis, com resultados explosivos.

en.title: Dough and Dynamite
en.overview: Pierre and Jacques are working as waiters at a restaurant where the cooks go on strike. When the two are forced to work as bakers, the striking cooks put dynamite in the dough, with explosive results.

pt-BR.title: O Presídio
pt-BR.overview: Convicted of manslaughter for a drunken driving accident, Kent Marlowe is sent to prison, where he meets vicious incarcerated figures who are planning an escape from the brutal conditions.

en.title: The Big House
en.overview: Convicted of manslaughter for a drunken driving accident, Kent Marlowe is sent to prison, where he meets vicious incarcerated figures who are planning an escape from the brutal conditions.
en.tagline: Timely! Tremendous! Thrilling! Drama of Love and a Jail-Break!

pt-BR.title: Indestructible Man
pt-BR.overview: A scientific experiment involving subjecting a corpse to an extreme charge of electricity accidentally revives an executed criminal and makes him impervious to harm, allowing him to seek revenge on his former partners, and deal similarly with anyone else who gets in his way.

en.title: Indestructible Man
en.overview: A scientific experiment involving subjecting a corpse to an extreme charge of electricity accidentally revives an executed criminal and makes him impervious to harm, allowing him to seek revenge on his former partners, and deal similarly with anyone else who gets in his way.
en.tagline: The Screen's 300,000 Volt SHOCKER!

pt-BR.title: Two Tars
pt-BR.overview: Two sailors on shore leave rent a car and go on a drive with their dates, but soon get involved in a huge traffic jam with dozens of ill-tempered motorists. A minor collision sets off an escalating series of retaliations.

en.title: Two Tars
en.overview: Two sailors on shore leave rent a car and go on a drive with their dates, but soon get involved in a huge traffic jam with dozens of ill-tempered motorists. A minor collision sets off an escalating series of retaliations.

pt-BR.title: Unaccustomed as We Are
pt-BR.overview: Laurel and Hardy try to entertain a female neighbor, unbeknown to Hardy’s wife.

en.title: Unaccustomed as We Are
en.overview: Laurel and Hardy try to entertain a female neighbor, unbeknown to Hardy’s wife.

pt-BR.title: Carregadores de Piano
pt-BR.overview: Carlitos e seu parceiro recebem a incumbência de entregar um piano em um local, e retirar outro em outro local. Eles confundem os locais e querem executar as tarefas mesmo que contra a vontade dos proprietários, até que, finalmente, o piano cai pela janela na rua.

en.title: His Musical Career
en.overview: Charlie and his partner are to deliver a piano to 666 Prospect St. and repossess one from 999 Prospect St.

originalTitle: The Life and Death of 9413: A Hollywood Extra

pt-BR.title: A vida e a Morte de 9413, a Hollywood Extra
pt-BR.overview: Um aspirante a estrela de cinema vivencia os horrores surreais da desumanização na base da escala social de Hollywood, à medida que suas esperanças de sucesso desaparecem e sua identidade é reduzida a um número.

en.title: The Life and Death of 9413: A Hollywood Extra
en.overview: This short experimental film tells the story of a man who comes to Hollywood to become a star, only to fail and be dehumanized. He is identified by the number 9413 written on his forehead.

pt-BR.title: They Go Boom!
pt-BR.overview: Stan and Ollie try to sleep in a room-for-rent. Ollie, suffering from a cold, coughs frequently, while Stan snores. Both of them have trouble falling asleep because of this. They try to solve their problems, but this results in total chaos.

en.title: They Go Boom!
en.overview: Stan and Ollie try to sleep in a room-for-rent. Ollie, suffering from a cold, coughs frequently, while Stan snores. Both of them have trouble falling asleep because of this. They try to solve their problems, but this results in total chaos.

pt-BR.title: Oi Doutor!
pt-BR.overview: Em vez de se divertir nas corridas de cavalos com a esposa e o filho mimado Junior, o próspero Dr. I.O. No entanto, como o jogador e sua namorada femme fatale se recusam a aceitar sua perda financeira, eles elaboram um plano ousado para não precisar voltar para casa de mãos vazias. Mas o sempre atento Junior já sabe muito. Ele pode salvar o dia?

en.title: Oh, Doctor!
en.overview: Roscoe is a doctor who falls in love with a pretty woman whose boyfriend, in turn, falls in love with Roscoe's wife's jewelry.

pt-BR.title: Michael
pt-BR.overview: A mature and visually elegant period romance that remains one of the earliest and most compassionate overtly gay-themed films in movie history. Based upon Herman Bang's 1902 novel, Dreyer's Michael refashions the classical Greek myth of Jupiter and Ganymede into a love triangle between an aging artist, Zoret, his protagonist Michael, and Princess Zamikoff, an aristocratic femme fatale as entranced by Michael’s youthful beauty as Zoret is.

en.title: Michael
en.overview: A mature and visually elegant period romance that remains one of the earliest and most compassionate overtly gay-themed films in movie history. Based upon Herman Bang's 1902 novel, Dreyer's Michael refashions the classical Greek myth of Jupiter and Ganymede into a love triangle between an aging artist, Zoret, his protagonist Michael, and Princess Zamikoff, an aristocratic femme fatale as entranced by Michael’s youthful beauty as Zoret is.

pt-BR.title: Despir Impossível
pt-BR.overview: Território familiar para Méliès, mas executado com perfeição. Vemos novamente o nosso protagonista “Ir para a cama sob dificuldades”, como indica o título, embora este filme também nos apresente um novo truque de Méliès, A Roupa Infinita. Na verdade, o título original em francês, Le déshabillage impossível, traduz-se como "Despir Impossível".

en.title: Going to Bed Under Difficulties
en.overview: A man takes off his clothes in preparation for bed, only for new clothes to spontaneously generate, leading to comical consternation.

video.file: Le dshabillage impossible AKA Going to Bed With Difficulties.mp4

pt-BR.title: The Gay Shoe Clerk
pt-BR.overview: A woman being fitted for shoes exposes her ankle to the shoe clerk, who is intrigued. He kisses her, but her chaperone hits him with her umbrella.

en.title: The Gay Shoe Clerk
en.overview: A woman being fitted for shoes exposes her ankle to the shoe clerk, who is intrigued. He kisses her, but her chaperone hits him with her umbrella.

pt-BR.title: Deixe-me Sonhar De Novo
pt-BR.overview: Deixe-me sonhar de novo é um filme de 1900 de George Albert Smith Sinopse. (0:06) Um senhor idoso se diverte bebendo em uma mesa com uma jovem mascarada: tudo parece estar indo bem até que o senhor acorda em sua cama abraçado por sua esposa idosa e irritada, percebendo isso Percebo que estava apenas sonhando.

en.title: Let Me Dream Again
en.overview: Possibly the first film to utilize the technique of focus pulling. A man kisses a beautiful and lively woman, then the image blurs and dissolves into a clear image of the man waking up to his nagging wife.

pt-BR.title: Sinos do Inferno
pt-BR.overview: Os demoniozinhos do inferno tocam música para Satã, cujo prazer se torna ira quando um demônio insubordinado se recusa a se tornar comida para Cérbero.

en.title: Hell's Bells
en.overview: The demons of hell play music for Satan, whose delight turns to wrath when an insubordinate refuses to become food for Cerberus.

pt-BR.title: Fantasma
pt-BR.overview: Quando Lorenz Lubota é atropelado, ele fica obcecado por Veronika, a misteriosa e sensual passageira do veículo. Mais um clássico expressionista de F. W. Murnau, o filme era considerado perdido até 2003.

en.title: Phantom
en.overview: Lorenz Lubota is a city clerk with no direction in life. One day on his way to work he is run over by a woman driving a chariot and he is immediately infatuated with her.

pt-BR.title: True Heart Susie
pt-BR.overview: “True Heart” Susie ama secretamente seu vizinho, William Jenkins mas, aparentemente, nenhum dos dois consegue confessar seus sentimentos para o outro. William então parte para a universidade. Ele volta, mas para a decepção de Susie, casado com uma jovem extravagante chamada Bettina.

en.title: True Heart Susie
en.overview: In a country town, Susie, innocent and big-hearted, quietly gives money to William Jenkins, a man she secretly yearns for, so he can attend college. After he graduates, he returns and becomes the town's minister. However, he never realizes how Susie feels about him and ignores her in favor of Bettina Hopkins, a wild and unfaithful girl who steals his heart. Susie must then find a way to show William that she's loved him all along.
en.tagline: The story of a plain girl

pt-BR.title: The Finishing Touch
pt-BR.overview: Stan and Ollie are hired to build a house in just one day. When they are done, a bird lands on the house and it collapses. Naturally, the owner wants his money back.

en.title: The Finishing Touch
en.overview: Stan and Ollie are hired to build a house in just one day. When they are done, a bird lands on the house and it collapses. Naturally, the owner wants his money back.

pt-BR.title: Blotto
pt-BR.overview: Stan fakes receiving a telegram so he can go to a club with Ollie and a bottle of his unsuspecting wife's liquor, but she overhears his plans.

en.title: Blotto
en.overview: Stan fakes receiving a telegram so he can go to a club with Ollie and a bottle of his unsuspecting wife's liquor, but she overhears his plans.

pt-BR.title: O Pesado
pt-BR.overview: Nick Van Alstyne owns the Henrietta silver mine and is very rich and his son Bertie is naive and spoiled. His daughter Rose is married to shady investor Mark. Mark wrecks Bertie's wedding plans by making him take the blame for Mark's illegitimate daughter, and also nearly ruins the family business by selling off some stock at too low a price.

en.title: The Saphead
en.overview: Nick Van Alstyne owns the Henrietta silver mine and is very rich and his son Bertie is naive and spoiled. His daughter Rose is married to shady investor Mark. Mark wrecks Bertie's wedding plans by making him take the blame for Mark's illegitimate daughter, and also nearly ruins the family business by selling off some stock at too low a price.

pt-BR.title: O Passado Pré-histórico
pt-BR.overview: Na idade da pedra, o Rei Lowbrow governa o reino e tem um harém de mulheres. Quando Weakchin chega a esse reino, ele se apaixona justamente pela sua donzela favorita.

en.title: His Prehistoric Past
en.overview: Set mostly in the Stone Age, a prehistoric king, with a harem of wives, rules a beach. Charlie arrives and falls for the king's favorite wife. In the end, it turns out to have been a dream; Charlie was asleep in the park.

pt-BR.title: O Operador Lonedale
pt-BR.overview: Quando seu pai adoece, uma jovem assume o telégrafo em uma estação ferroviária solitária no oeste. Logo ela tem que deter dois bandidos que estão decididos a roubar a folha de pagamento de um trem que está chegando.

en.title: The Lonedale Operator
en.overview: A young woman takes over her sick father's role as telegraph operator at a railway station, and has to deal with a team intent on train robbery.

pt-BR.title: Satan's Rhapsody
pt-BR.overview: A Faustian tale about an old woman who makes a pact with Mephisto to regain her youth, but in return she must stay away from love. After making the deal, she meets two brothers who fall in love with her.

en.title: Satan's Rhapsody
en.overview: A Faustian tale about an old woman who makes a pact with Mephisto to regain her youth, but in return she must stay away from love. After making the deal, she meets two brothers who fall in love with her.

pt-BR.title: Back Stage
pt-BR.overview: Roscoe and Buster give a bullying Strongman the what-for, but after the performance troupe quits it's up to Fatty and Buster to keep the show going.

en.title: Back Stage
en.overview: Roscoe and Buster give a bullying Strongman the what-for, but after the performance troupe quits it's up to Fatty and Buster to keep the show going.
en.tagline: The terrible tale of a stage carpenter who saw so much that he sawed but little.

pt-BR.title: Orquestra maluca
pt-BR.overview: Membros de uma banda municipal, Stanley e Oliver parecem estar sempre seguindo o exemplo de outra pessoa, ao invés do temperamental maestro. Logo eles ficam sem emprego, assim como seus alojamentos quando a senhoria descobre que eles foram demitidos. Os meninos tentam a sorte de serem músicos de rua, mas as brigas entre eles logo se espalham para os transeuntes em geral, até que a rua se enche de homens tirando as calças uns dos outros.

en.title: You're Darn Tootin'
en.overview: Members of a municipal band, Stanley and Oliver seem to be always following someone else's lead, rather than that of the temperamental conductor.

pt-BR.title: O Mágico de Oz
pt-BR.overview: A pequena Dorothy morava com os tios Henry e Em em uma pequena fazenda do Kansas. Seu único amigo era o cãozinho Totó que, durante uma tempestade, desaparece. Procurando-o desesperadamente, a menina entra no abrigo contra tornados e esconde-se na pequena casa que, levada pelos ares, termina por arremessá-la numa distante e desconhecida terra.  No meio da tempestade, Dorothy encontra seu animalzinho. Quando finalmente pousam, descobre que a casa caíra sobre uma perigosa bruxa, matando-a. Surgem alguns homenzinhos - os Munchkins - que eram dominados por aquela malvada senhora. Dorothy é aclamada como heroína, por ter matado a Bruxa Malvada do Leste.

en.title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
en.overview: An early version of the classic, based more on the 1902 stage musical than on the original novel.

pt-BR.title: A Conquista do Pólo
pt-BR.overview: Cientistas de todo o mundo estão reunidos para discutir a melhor maneira de chegar ao Polo Norte. O professor Maboul demonstra para eles o equipamento inovador que projetou para o fim. Quando tudo está pronto, Maboul e vários outros cientistas se separam do poste. A viagem deles proporcionará ser ainda mais agitada do que o esperado.

en.title: The Conquest of the Pole
en.overview: A science fantasy film that deals with an extraordinary race to the north pole by rival parties of balloonists. Based on the novel "The Adventures of Captain Hatteras" by Jules Verne.

video.file: 1912 Georges Méliès À la Conquête du Pôle (Conquest of the North Pole).mp4

pt-BR.title: A Rua das Lágrimas
pt-BR.overview: Viena, anos 1920. Duas mulheres nem imaginavam, mas teriam seus destinos completamente mudados por acasos do destino. Vivendo com dificuldade na tumultuada capital da Áustria afetada grandemente pela Primeira Guerra Mundial, uma delas acaba se tornando prostitua e a outra por sorte é salva pelo amor de um americano da Cruz Vermelha

en.title: Joyless Street
en.overview: In 1921, we follow two women - Marie and Grete - from the same poor Viennese neighborhood, as they try to better the lives of themselves and their families during the period of Austrian postwar hyperinflation.
en.tagline: Open any door in Melchior Alley, and you'll come face to face with naked misery.

pt-BR.title: Grandma's Boy
pt-BR.overview: A meek young man must find the courage within when a rogue tramp menaces his hometown.

en.title: Grandma's Boy
en.overview: A meek young man must find the courage within when a rogue tramp menaces his hometown.
en.tagline: Where Laughter Reigns and Joy Pours!

pt-BR.title: Nunca fraqueje
pt-BR.overview: Nosso herói está apaixonado por uma garota no escritório ao lado. A fim de angariar negócios para seu chefe, um osteopata, ele consegue que um amigo ator finja ferimentos que o médico "cura", construindo assim uma reputação. Quando ele ouve que sua namorada está se casando com outro, ele decide cometer suicídio e passa a maior parte do filme em emocionantes tentativas fracassadas.

en.title: Never Weaken
en.overview: A young man schemes to drum up business for his girlfriend's employer but after seeing her being intimate with another man, he attempts to commit suicide.
en.tagline: A skyscraper romance, starting with a laugh and ending with a thrill. It's a great life!

pt-BR.title: The Wizard of Oz
pt-BR.overview: A farm girl learns she is a princess and is swept away by a tornado to the land of Oz.

en.title: The Wizard of Oz
en.overview: A farm girl learns she is a princess and is swept away by a tornado to the land of Oz.
en.tagline: The worlds greatest fantastic spectacle.

pt-BR.title: Night Owls
pt-BR.overview: Policeman Edgar Kennedy is told by his chief he better stop a string of burglaries that have been happening on his watch or else he will get the sack. He persuades vagrants Stan and Ollie to rob the chief's house so he can regain his reputation by catching them. The policeman promises to later get the boys off. Things do not go as planned.

en.title: Night Owls
en.overview: Policeman Edgar Kennedy is told by his chief he better stop a string of burglaries that have been happening on his watch or else he will get the sack. He persuades vagrants Stan and Ollie to rob the chief's house so he can regain his reputation by catching them. The policeman promises to later get the boys off. Things do not go as planned.

pt-BR.title: Febre do Xadrez
pt-BR.overview: Com um torneio internacional de xadrez em andamento, um jovem fica completamente obcecado pelo jogo. Sua noiva não tem interesse algum nisso e fica frustrada e deprimida com a negligência dele, mas onde quer que vá, ela descobre que não consegue escapar do xadrez. À beira de desistir, ela conhece o campeão mundial, o próprio Capablanca, com resultados interessantes.

en.title: Chess Fever
en.overview: With an international chess tournament in progress, a young man becomes completely obsessed with the game. His fiancée has no interest in it, and becomes frustrated and depressed by his neglect of her, but wherever she goes she finds that she cannot escape chess. On the brink of giving up, she meets the world champion, Capablanca himself, with interesting results.

pt-BR.title: Carlitos Entre o Bar e o Amor
pt-BR.overview: Carlitos, bastante bêbado, entra em um bar para beber e, tendo perdido todo o controle, começa a provocar desastres. A ação continua com novos incidentes quando, já na rua, segue uma linda moça até sua casa.

en.title: His Favorite Pastime
en.overview: A very plastered fella follows a pretty woman home, and proceeds to make a nuisance of himself.

pt-BR.title: O Engano
pt-BR.overview: Clarence e seu amigo Ambrose se encontram em um restaurante e, acidentalmente, trocam de casaco. Clarence ia pegar uma mamadeira e Ambrose ia enviar uma carta de amor que estava em seu casaco. A esposa de Clarence encontra a carta e pensa que ele tem uma amante, e a esposa de Ambrose acha a mamadeira e pensa que ele tem um filho com outra mulher. Discussões acontecem no parque e, quando tudo está praticamente resolvido, Clarence arruma outra confusão com o outro casal, ao mostrar para a esposa de seu amigo a carta que estava em seu bolso.

en.title: His Trysting Places
en.overview: On his way to a restaurant, Ambrose, a happily married man, obliges to mail a letter for a woman in the apartment lobby. Unbeknownst to him, the letter is about a rendezvous with her own lover at their "trysting place".  Elsewhere, after some domestic frustration, Charlie runs an errand to buy a baby bottle before stopping at the same restaurant. After a confrontation there, they both inadvertently leave with each other's coats. Later, their wives independently discover what appears to be incriminating evidence of extramarital affairs from the pockets of the swapped garments. It all comes to a head when all four of them find themselves at the "trysting place" in the park.

pt-BR.title: The Bond
pt-BR.overview: A propaganda film created by Charlie Chaplin at his own expense for the Liberty Load Committee to help sell U.S. Liberty Bonds during World War I. The story is a series of sketches humorously illustrating various bonds like the bond of friendship and of marriage and, most important, the Liberty Bond, to K.O. the Kaiser which Charlie does literally.

en.title: The Bond
en.overview: A propaganda film created by Charlie Chaplin at his own expense for the Liberty Load Committee to help sell U.S. Liberty Bonds during World War I. The story is a series of sketches humorously illustrating various bonds like the bond of friendship and of marriage and, most important, the Liberty Bond, to K.O. the Kaiser which Charlie does literally.

pt-BR.title: Asphalt
pt-BR.overview: Starring Betty Amann in her most famous leading role, Joe May's Asphalt is a luxuriously produced German Expressionist classic where tragic liaisons and fatal encounters are shaped alongside the constant roar of Berlin traffic.

en.title: Asphalt
en.overview: Starring Betty Amann in her most famous leading role, Joe May's Asphalt is a luxuriously produced German Expressionist classic where tragic liaisons and fatal encounters are shaped alongside the constant roar of Berlin traffic.

pt-BR.title: Cœur fidèle
pt-BR.overview: The good guys win out in this sweet tale about a young orphan who is abused for much of her life but who eventually finds happiness when she marries an honest man who extricates her from her situation.

en.title: Cœur fidèle
en.overview: The good guys win out in this sweet tale about a young orphan who is abused for much of her life but who eventually finds happiness when she marries an honest man who extricates her from her situation.

originalTitle: Demolishing and Building Up the Star Theatre

pt-BR.title: Demolishing and Building Up the Star Theatre
pt-BR.overview: Time-lapse photography showing the one month-long demolition of the Star Theatre in New York.

en.title: Demolishing and Building Up the Star Theatre
en.overview: Time-lapse photography showing the one month-long demolition of the Star Theatre in New York.

video.file: Demolishing and Building Up the Star Theatre.mp4

pt-BR.title: O Incrível Senhor X
pt-BR.overview: Christine ainda não conseguiu superar a morte do marido em um acidente de carro e contrata os serviços de um carismático homem que diz ser capaz de se comunicar com os mortos.

en.title: The Amazing Mr. X
en.overview: On the beach one night, Christine Faber, two years a widow, thinks she hears her late husband Paul calling out of the surf...then meets a tall dark man, Alexis, who seems to know all about such things. After more ghostly manifestations, Christine and younger sister Janet become enmeshed in the eerie artifices of Alexis; but he in turn finds himself manipulated into deeper deviltry than he had in mind...
en.tagline: In his eyes, the threat of terror! In his hands, the power to destroy!

pt-BR.title: Minha Rainha
pt-BR.overview: No imaginário país europeu de Cobourg-Nassau, em algum momento antes da Primeira Guerra Mundial, a cruel rainha Regina V se torna obcecada por seu noivo irresponsável, o príncipe Wolfram. Quando ele conhece Patricia Kelly, uma jovem inocente e provocante que vive em um convento, acaba se apaixonando por ela. Ansioso para vê-la antes do casamento, Wolfram leva Kelly ao palácio. Ao descobrir os dois juntos, a rainha a açoita e a expulsa. Chamada ao leito de morte de sua tia, Kelly fica chocada ao se ver em um bordel. Em seus últimos momentos, a tia implora que a jovem se case com Jan, o rico e sifilítico dono do lugar.

en.title: Queen Kelly
en.overview: A convent girl is abducted and seduced by a prince before being sent off to a brothel in East Africa.
en.tagline: The silent film masterpiece that never was... Until now.

pt-BR.title: Alvorada do Amor
pt-BR.overview: A história da Rainha Louise da Sylvania (Jeanette MacDonald) e o seu novo marido, Conde Alfred (Maurice Chevalier). Embora o Conde Alfred tenha prometido, na cerimónia de casamento, ser um marido dócil, ele depressa se arrepende da sua decisão a partir do momento em que as suas ordens não são obedecidas e se vai tornando enfastiado com a vida que leva. Ameaçando partir para Paris, ele só é detido pela Rainha Louise quando ela lhe oferece o equivalente aos poderes de um rei...
pt-BR.tagline: Um beijo e todo o reino era dele!

en.title: The Love Parade
en.overview: The queen of mythical Sylvania marries a courtier, who finds his new life unsatisfying
en.tagline: He sang himself into the Queen's boudoir! One kiss and the whole kingdom was his!

pt-BR.title: Carlitos e a Patroa
pt-BR.overview: Charlie é o hóspede favorito de sua “senhoria”, e os outros pensionistas morrem de ciúmes. Um show de sombras chinesas conduzido pelo filho dos donos da pensão causa embaraço a todos e produz um alvoroço no local.

en.title: The Star Boarder
en.overview: A fun-loving little boy's magic lantern show exposes some indiscreet moments between his landlady mother and her star boarder.

originalTitle: The Face on the Barroom Floor

pt-BR.title: Pintor Apaixonado
pt-BR.overview: Baseado em um poema de mesmo título, este filme fala de uma desilusão amorosa. Alguns dos versos originais foram modificados para se adaptar ao estilo dos filmes de Carlitos, nos quais a vida é o jogo mais engraçado que existe

en.title: The Face on the Barroom Floor
en.overview: A painter turned tramp (Chaplin), devastated by losing the woman he was courting as a wealthy man, finds himself drunk and getting drunker by the minute with some sailors at a bar until he's literally falling down. He keeps futilely trying to draw the woman's picture on the floor with a piece of chalk until he finally passes out cold (or perhaps dies, as in the poem) at the end of the film.

video.file: The Face on the Bar Room Floor.mp4

pt-BR.title: A Caminhada Infernal do Bolo
pt-BR.overview: Méliès interpretou o diavolo e provou ser uma boa bailarina. Este filme é desenhado e produzido em um estilo que pode definir a expressão. Fundo preto no centro da cena, consistente com Méliès no que diz respeito ao realinhamento e seus efeitos (pressão e dupla pressão). Nas profundezas do inferno um grupo de espíritos demoníacos é entretido pelo Cake-walk, dançando muito popularmente com cavallo de 1800 a 1900. Satana (Georges Méliès) aparece tra loro et dopo essersi Quando se trata de dança, convida um grupo de bailarinas profissionais para se apresentar no palco e ainda tem uma cópia em black-face.

en.title: The Infernal Cake-Walk
en.overview: Pluto, having seen the earth, comes back home amazed at the success of that well-known dance, the "cake-walk." He has brought back with him two noted well-known dancers, who start their favorite dance amidst the flames.

pt-BR.title: História de um Crime
pt-BR.overview: Um homem invade um banco e, para realizar um assalto, mata o funcionário que dormia no interior do prédio. Feito o crime, o criminoso se vê sentado à mesa de um bar esbanjando o dinheiro roubado, mas é preso, levado diante do cadáver do funcionário, julgado e condenado. Deitado na cama de sua cela, o criminoso tem um estranho sonho em que vê sua vida antes do roubo: ele é um carpinteiro honesto, com uma família feliz e uma existência normal, mas apesar de tudo isso o homem começa a beber, sim ele dá para o submundo e até mata.

en.title: History of a Crime
en.overview: A convicted criminal dreams about his past the night before his execution.

video.file: Histoire d'un crime AKA History of a Crime.mp4

pt-BR.title: Light-Play Opus I
pt-BR.overview: Against a dark background, several bright, curved or rounded shapes pulse towards the center of the screen, one at a time. They are followed by many other shapes, some irregular, some pointed, others rounded. The abstract shapes move into or across the screen in harmony with the musical score.

en.title: Light-Play Opus I
en.overview: Against a dark background, several bright, curved or rounded shapes pulse towards the center of the screen, one at a time. They are followed by many other shapes, some irregular, some pointed, others rounded. The abstract shapes move into or across the screen in harmony with the musical score.

pt-BR.title: Carlitos e a Sonâmbula

pt-BR.title: The Untamable Whiskers
pt-BR.overview: The background of this picture represents a scene along the beautiful river Seine in Paris. A gentleman enters, and taking a blackboard from the side of the picture, he draws on it a sketch of a novelist. Then, standing in the centre, he causes the living features of his sketch to appear in the place of his own, which is utterly devoid of whiskers. The change is made so mysteriously that the eye cannot notice it until one sees quite another person in the place of the first. Again another sketch is shown on the board, this one being that of a miser; then an English cockney; a comic character; a French policeman, and last of all, the grinning visage of Mephistopheles. It is almost impossible to give this film a more definite description; suffice it to say that it is something entirely new in motion pictures and is sure to please. (Méliès Catalog)

pt-BR.title: Gulliver's Travels Among the Lilliputians and the Giants
pt-BR.overview: Georges Méliès' adaptation of Jonathan Swift's "Gulliver's Travels" is most distinguished, today, for being a color film of the classic story. Color was rare in 1902 (and many years after) as non-tinted color has to be hand painted on the film; this was an arduous task. Also notable is the film's short running time of approximately five minutes. Much of the original work is not covered, but viewers were expected to be familiar with the story, and enjoy the filmed highlights. There are a couple of scenes missing; according to contemporary reports, Gulliver's shipwreck was certainly included. You can do a lot in a few minutes, as Mr. Méliès includes a re-make of his own "Une partie de cartes" (1896), which already looked like something previously covered by the Lumière Brothers.

Brant finds out that 'Jones', one of the outlaws he has become friends with, committed the murder that Brant was sent up for, but has no knowledge that anyone was ever put in jail for his crime. Willing to forgive and forget, Brant doesn't realize that 'Jones' has not only fallen for the same pretty shopgirl Brant has, but begins to suspect that Brant is not truly an outlaw.

Dezoito anos depois, ele se tornou o líder de uma tribo africana, parte de seu plano para liquidar Crane. No meio de tanto ódio, a criança, agora uma mulher, se tornou uma prostituta alcoólatra em Zanzibar. pt-BR.overview: A penniless troubadour consults witch Carabosse about his future, but offends her by paying with a bag of sand. He evades the witch's revenge, and saves the beautiful princess.

originalTitle: The Story of the Kelly Gang

pt-BR.title: The Story of the Kelly Gang
pt-BR.overview: A verdadeira história do fora-da-lei australiano Ned Kelly.

en.title: The Story of the Kelly Gang
en.overview: Just as Galeen and Wegener's Der Golem (1915) can be seen as a  testament to early German film artistry, The Story of the Kelly Gang (1906) symbolizes both the birth of the Australian film industry and the emergence of an Australian cinema identity. Even more significantly, it heralds the emergence of the feature film format. However, only fragments of the original production of more than one hour are known to exist, preserved at the National Film and Sound Archive, Canberra; Efforts at reconstruction have made the film available to modern audiences.
en.tagline: The Most Sensational, The Most Thrilling and Interesting LIVING PICTURES EVER TAKEN.

pt-BR.title: Men O' War
pt-BR.overview: Os marinheiros Stan e Ollie se oferecem para comprar refrigerantes para duas mulheres que encontram em um parque, mesmo estando sem dinheiro. Por sorte, Stan ganha o prêmio máximo em uma máquina caça-níqueis e os rapazes têm dinheiro suficiente para alugar um barco e passear em um lago. Logo, eles se envolvem em uma confusão com outros barcos e todos acabam na água.

en.title: Men O' War
en.overview: Sailors Stan and Ollie offer to buy sodas for two women they meet in a park, even though they are short on cash. Luckily Stan wins the jackpot on a slot machine and the boys have enough money to rent a boat to cruise on a lake. They soon tangle with other boaters and everyone ends up in the water.

pt-BR.title: The Hilarious Posters
pt-BR.overview: A wall full of advertising posters comes to life.

en.title: The Hilarious Posters

pt-BR.title: Pool Sharks
pt-BR.overview: Two romantic rivals play a game of pool for the hand of their lady love. W.C. Field's debut film.

en.title: Pool Sharks
en.overview: Two romantic rivals play a game of pool for the hand of their lady love. W.C. Field's debut film.

pt-BR.title: Carlitos na Contra-regra
pt-BR.overview: Trabalhando em um teatro, Carlitos tem de enfrentar problemas com os equipamentos dos atores e conflitos na distribuição dos camarins.

en.title: The Property Man
en.overview: Charlie is in charge of stage props and has trouble with actors' luggage and conflicts over who gets the star's dressing room. Once all that is resolved the next issue is getting everyone on stage with the correct backdrop.

pt-BR.title: Os Mendigos da Vida
pt-BR.overview: Depois de matar o seu padrasto traidor, uma rapariga tenta fugir do país com um jovem vagabundo. Ela disfarça-se de rapaz e, na tentativa de escapar à polícia e chegar ao Canadá, os dois saltam para comboios de mercadorias, discutem com um grupo de vagabundos e roubam um carro.

en.title: Beggars of Life
en.overview: After killing her treacherous step-father, a girl tries to escape the country with a young vagabond. She dresses as a boy, they hop freight trains, quarrel with a group of hobos, and steal a car in their attempt to escape the police, and reach Canada.
en.tagline: A Glimpse of the Ways of the Wanderer

pt-BR.title: Regeneração
pt-BR.overview: At 10 years old, Owen becomes a ragged orphan when his mother dies. Abusive next-door neighbors the Conways take him in, and by 17, Owen has learned that might is right. At 25, he's a career gangster: loitering, gambling and drinking in dens of iniquity. Marie Deering arrives in Owen's area, eager to empower the impoverished, gang-affiliated youth through education. Owen slowly but surely leaves his old life behind, choosing the narrow path- all the while falling in love with Marie. Skinny, who's taken over Owen's role in the gang, reappears to him, spelling trouble.

originalTitle: Die Spinnen, 1. Teil - Der Goldene See

pt-BR.title: As Aranhas, Parte 2: O Barco de Diamantes
pt-BR.overview: Segunda parte da cinessérie "As Aranhas", que foi feita em duas partes, planejadas para serem exibidas em duas datas diferentes. Os planos de Fritz Lang eram para completar a série com uma terceira e quarta parte, que nunca se realizaram.

en.title: The Spiders: Part 1 - The Golden Sea
en.overview: In San Francisco, well-known sportsman Kay Hoog announces to a club that he has found a message in a bottle with a map drawn by a Harvard professor who has gone missing. The map tells of a lost Incan civilization that possesses an immense treasure. Hoog immediately plans an expedition to find it. But Lio Sha, the head of a criminal organization known as the Spiders, is determined to get the treasure for herself and plans a rival expedition.

pt-BR.title: Lucky Star
pt-BR.overview: Mary, a poor farm girl, meets Tim just as word comes that war has been declared. Tim enlists in the army and goes to the battlefields of Europe, where he is wounded and loses the use of his legs. Home again, Tim is visited by Mary, and they are powerfully attracted to each other; but his physical handicap prevents him from declaring his love for her. Deeper complications set in when Martin, Tim's former sergeant and a bully, takes a shine to Mary.

en.title: Lucky Star
en.overview: Mary, a poor farm girl, meets Tim just as word comes that war has been declared. Home again, Tim is visited by Mary, and they are powerfully attracted to each other; but his physical handicap prevents him from declaring his love for her. en.tagline: THE ONLY PICTURE GREAT ENOUGH TO MAKE YOU FORGET "STREET ANGEL"-"SEVETH HEAVEN"

pt-BR.title: Depois da Morte
pt-BR.overview: Young scholar Andrei, fascinated by haunting actress Zoia Kadmina, is surprised when she sends him a note. The two have a brief scheduled meeting, then three months later Andrei is shocked to learn she has died. He becomes obsessed with Zoia's memory and decides he must find out all that he can about her.

en.title: After Death

He becomes obsessed with Zoia's memory and decides he must find out all that he can about her.

pt-BR.title: New York Subway
pt-BR.overview: The camera platform was on the front of a New York subway train following another train on the same track. Lighting is provided by a specially constructed work car on a parallel track. At the time of filming, the subway was only seven months old, having opened on October 27, 1904. The ride begins at 14th Street (Union Square) following the route of today's east side IRT, and ends at the old Grand Central Station, built by Cornelius Vanderbuilt in 1869. The Grand Central Station in use today was not completed until 1913.

pt-BR.title: Fire!
pt-BR.overview: Firefighters ring for help, and here comes the ladder cart; they hitch a horse to it. A second horse-drawn truck joins the first, and they head down the street to a house fire. Inside a man sleeps, he awakes amidst flames and throws himself back on the bed. In comes a firefighter, hosing down the blaze. He carries out the victim, down a ladder to safety. Other firefighters enter the house to save belongings, and out comes one with a baby. The saved man rejoices, but it's not over yet.

pt-BR.overview: Oswald finge ser um salva-vidas para impressionar Fanny Cottontail. Mas quando Fanny começa a se afogar no mar, será que Oswald conseguirá salvá-la a tempo?

en.title: All Wet
en.overview: Oswald takes a job as a lifeguard to keep an eye on Miss Rabbit, who in turn stages a boating accident hoping Oswald will come to save her.
en.tagline: Oswald pretends to be a beach lifeguard to impress Fanny Cottontail.

pt-BR.title: Sombra de Sangue
pt-BR.overview: Uma gangue que trabalha para The Shadow está aterrorizando a cidade. John Travers decide assumir o cargo de xerife e fazer algo a respeito.

en.title: The Star Packer
en.overview: John Travers and Yak, his faithful Indian sidekick, pick up where a murdered sheriff leaves off, and try to nab the mysterious Shadow.
en.tagline: He fought for justice... and battled for love!

pt-BR.title: Cowboy às Avessas
pt-BR.overview: Um jovem em Nova York exasperou seu pai por causa de sua farra constante e irresponsabilidade, então seu pai o manda para o rancho de seu tio no oeste. O jovem chega à cidade de Piute Pass, que está sendo aterrorizada por Tiger Lip Tompkins e sua gangue, os Masked Angels. O oriental faz amizade com uma jovem cujo pai está sendo mantido em cativeiro por Tompkins e decide ajudá-la.

en.title: An Eastern Westerner
en.overview: A young man in New York has exasperated his father because of his constant carousing and irresponsibility, so his father sends him to his uncle's ranch in the west. The young man arrives in the town of Piute Pass, which is being terrorized by Tiger Lip Tompkins and his gang, the Masked Angels. The Easterner befriends a young woman whose father is being held captive by Tompkins, and he decides to help her.
en.tagline: A riot of rollicking fun!

pt-BR.title: Moonshine
pt-BR.overview: A feud between the Owens and the Gillettes ends when the last remaining Gillette is killed, but new trouble erupts for the mountain folk with the arrival of a U.S. revenue agent and his assistant.

en.title: Moonshine
en.overview: A feud between the Owens and the Gillettes ends when the last remaining Gillette is killed, but new trouble erupts for the mountain folk with the arrival of a U.S. revenue agent and his assistant.

pt-BR.title: Sangue Sobre o Sol
pt-BR.overview: Nick Condon, jornalista americano em Tóquio, publica um violento artigo sobre a política expansionista japonesa revelando a existência do "plano Tanaka", um projeto desenvolvido por um grupo de militares sob as ordens do coronel Tojo, visando estabelecer a hegemonia do Japão sobre o Extremo Oriente.

en.title: Blood on the Sun
en.overview: Nick Condon, an American journalist in 20s Tokyo, publishes the Japanese master plan for world domination. Reaction from the understandably upset Japanese provides the action, but this is overshadowed by the propaganda of the time.
en.tagline: Having a wonderful time In Tokyo!

pt-BR.title: Alice no País das Maravilhas
pt-BR.overview: Filme mudo norte-americano da adaptação do clássido de Lewis Carroll. Alice vai com sua irmã para um piquenique e, em seguida, ela cai no sono e começa a sonhar com uma terra de maravilhas, cheia de animais falantes e andantes cartas de baralho.

en.title: Alice in Wonderland
en.overview: Alice goes with her sister to a picnic and then she falls asleep and starts dreaming about a wonderland full of talking animals and walking playing cards.

pt-BR.title: O Círculo do Casamento
pt-BR.overview: An unhappily married couple moves to Vienna, where the wife’s married best friend lives, and soon, sparks fly between the wife and the best friend’s husband.

en.title: The Marriage Circle
en.overview: An unhappily married couple moves to Vienna, where the wife’s married best friend lives, and soon, sparks fly between the wife and the best friend’s husband.
en.tagline: The oft told story.  His Best Friend and His Wife and ---

pt-BR.title: Abraham Lincoln
pt-BR.overview: Um marco no cinema, este filme do legendário diretor Griffith, é a primeira obra biográfica da era dos filmes "falados" e a primeira na tentativa de narrar a vida do Presidente Lincoln desde sua infância até a sua morte, incluindo o martírio na Guerra Civil.

en.title: Abraham Lincoln
en.overview: An episodic dramatization of the 18th President of the United States' life, including his early years, affair with Ann Rutledge, courtship of Mary Todd, debates with Stephen A. Douglas, the election of 1860, his presidency during the Civil War, and finally his assassination at Ford's Theater in 1865.
en.tagline: The wonder film of the century, about the most romantic figure who ever lived!

pt-BR.title: Concerto no Quintal
pt-BR.overview: Mickey leads an 8-piece orchestra (that's counting the bass played by three birds as one) through the most recognizable parts of the Poet and Peasant Overture. The setting, as the title implies, is a barnyard, and some of the instrumentation reflects that (including various animals used as instruments, like a tuned group of piglets whose tails Mickey pulls).

pt-BR.title: O Mar Imutável
pt-BR.overview: In this story set at a seaside fishing village and inspired by a Charles Kingsley poem, a young couple's happy life is turned about by an accident. The husband, although saved from drowning, loses his memory. A child is on the way, and soon a daughter is born to his wife. We watch the passage of time, as his daughter matures and his wife ages. The daughter becomes a lovely young woman, herself ready for marriage. One day on the beach, the familiarity of the sea and the surroundings triggers a return of her father's memory, and we are reminded that although people age and change, the sea and the ways of the fisherfolk remain eternal.

pt-BR.overview: Quando os "eternos" estudantes universitários Danny O'Neill e Hank Taylor são forçados a viver por conta própria, a competitiva dupla consegue emprego temporário com a banda de Artie Shaw. Danny e Hank são surpreendidos quando Artie Shaw contrata a competente gerente Ellen Miller que era lá da sua banda de faculdade. O dois trompetistas tentam esquemas para se enquadrar na banda de Shaw, cada um tentando sabotar a jogada do outro.

en.title: Second Chorus
en.overview: Danny O'Neill and Hank Taylor are rival trumpeters with the Perennials, a college band, and both men are still attending college by failing their exams seven years in a row. In the midst of a performance, Danny spies Ellen Miller who ends up being made band manager. Both men compete for her affections while trying to get the other one fired.
en.tagline: They're the tip-tops in toe-taps!

pt-BR.title: The Land Beyond the Sunset
pt-BR.overview: A poor young boy goes on a field trip and dreams of escaping to a land beyond the sunset.

en.title: The Land Beyond the Sunset
en.overview: A poor young boy goes on a field trip and dreams of escaping to a land beyond the sunset.

originalTitle: Le Diable géant ou Le miracle de la madonne

pt-BR.title: The Devil and the Statue
pt-BR.overview: At the beginning of the scene Romeo in his gondola sings to Juliet a sentimental song, then goes away. Hardly has he departed when the colonnade falls to pieces, disclosing the devil. Juliet, frightened, runs to the window and calls Romeo. The latter attempts to enter and protect his fiancée, but at a gesture from the devil the window is instantly covered with a grating and Romeo makes frantic efforts to break it. The devil begins to dance a wild dance before Juliet, who is beside herself from terror. The devil gradually becomes the size of a giant (a novel effect). Juliet implores the statue of Madonna, which becomes animated, descends from its pedestal, and stretching out its arms orders the devil to disappear. (Méliès Catalog)

pt-BR.tagline: Pobre Cinderela

en.title: Poor Cinderella
en.overview: In the only Betty Boop color cartoon, Cinderella (Betty) goes to the ball thanks to her fairy godmother. Later, only her foot fits the glass slipper.

pt-BR.title: Swing You Sinners!
pt-BR.overview: Bimbo is seen late at night, trying to steal a chicken. He runs away from a policeman and enters a haunted cemetery. Various ghosts and monsters tell him that he will be punished for his sin.

pt-BR.title: Areia Movediça
pt-BR.overview: Young auto mechanic Dan Brady takes $20 from a cash register at work to go on a date with blonde femme fatale Vera Novak. Brady intends to put the money back before it is missed, but the garage's bookkeeper shows up earlier than scheduled. As Brady scrambles to cover evidence of his petty theft, he fast finds himself drawn into an ever worsening "quicksand" of crime.

pt-BR.title: O Médico do Campo
pt-BR.overview: Enquanto cuida de sua filha doente, um médico é chamado para ir até o leito de um vizinho. Ele encontra o vizinho gravemente doente e ignora os apelos de sua esposa para voltar para casa e cuidar de sua própria filha, que piorou.

en.title: The Country Doctor
en.overview: While caring for his sick daughter, a doctor is called away to the sickbed of a neighbor. He finds the neighbor gravely ill, and ignores his wife's pleas to come home and care for his own daughter, who has taken a turn for the worse.

pt-BR.title: Fantasmas Assombrados
pt-BR.overview: Depois de várias tentativas frustradas de suicídio, nosso herói (Lloyd) encontra um advogado que está procurando um fantoche para substituir o noivo a fim de garantir uma herança para seu cliente (Davis). A herança é uma casa, que seu tio intrigante "assombra" para assustá-los e reivindicar a propriedade.

en.title: Haunted Spooks
en.overview: After numerous failed attempts to commit suicide, our hero (Lloyd) runs into a lawyer who is looking for a stooge to stand in as a groom in order to secure an inheritance for his client (Davis). The inheritance is a house, which her scheming uncle "haunts" so that he can scare them off and claim the property.
en.tagline: Bar none, the greatest two reel Comedy ever made!

pt-BR.title: Aleluia
pt-BR.overview: Zeke, meeiro nas lavouras de algodão, perde a cabeça, as economias e a dignidade por causa da bela Chick. Zeke vai embora, porém, salvo pela religião, volta como um eloquente pastor. Sua veemência resulta em muitos seguidores, inclusive Chick, mas ele agora está interessado em Missy Rose. Chick fará de tudo para tê-lo de volta.
pt-BR.tagline: OUÇA E VEJA 100 CANTORES DO JUBILEU!

en.title: Hallelujah
en.overview: A black laborer turns preacher after accidentally killing a man.
en.tagline: HEAR AND SEE 100 JUBILEE SINGERS!

pt-BR.title: Erotikon
pt-BR.overview: Erotikon is a 1920 Swedish romantic comedy film directed by Mauritz Stiller, starring Tora Teje, Karin Molander, Anders de Wahl and Lars Hanson. It is based on the 1917 play A kék róka by Ferenc Herczeg. The story revolves around an entomology professor obsessed with the sexual life of bugs, and his easygoing wife who is courted by two suitors.

en.title: Seven Years Bad Luck
en.overview: After breaking a mirror in his home, superstitious Max tries to avoid situations which could bring bad luck, but in doing so causes himself the worst luck imaginable.

pt-BR.title: Scrooge; or Marley's Ghost
pt-BR.overview: Filmed in 35mm and in black and white, this short silent film was produced by the English film pioneer R. W. Paul, and directed by Walter R. Booth and was filmed at Paul's Animatograph Works. It was released in November 1901. As was common in cinema's early days, the filmmakers chose to adapt an already well-known story, in this case A Christmas Carol by Charles Dickens, in the belief that the audience's familiarity with the story would result in the need for fewer intertitles. It was presented in 'Twelve Tableaux' or scenes.

pt-BR.overview: A stationary camera looks on as two dapper gents play a game of chess. One drinks and smokes, and when he looks away, his opponent moves two pieces. A fight ensues, first with the squirting of a seltzer bottle, then with fisticuffs. The combatants wrestle each other to the floor and continue the fight out of the camera's view, hidden by the table. The waiter arrives to haul both of them out.

pt-BR.overview: Almirantado Britânico encarrega dois oficiais para juntarem provas para condenar o Capitão Kidd por pirataria. Trata-se de um raríssimo seriado de cinema de apenas 15 capítulos da década de 50 Pura Nostalgia!

en.title: Captain Kidd
en.overview: Cutthroat pirate William Kidd captures Admiral Blayne's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a respectable merchant captain, offers his services to the King of England. Seeking a social position, Kidd also negotiates for Blayne's title and lands, provided he can prove Blayne was associated with piracy. Launched upon his royal mission, Kidd is unaware that Blayne's son Adam is among the crew, determined to clear his father's name.
en.tagline: Swashbuckling Adventure of the PRINCE of PIRATES!

pt-BR.title: Laugh, Clown, Laugh
pt-BR.overview: A despairing clown suffering a broken heart and a self-indulgent count who uncontrollably laughs learn to help each other with their problems, but both fall in love with the same young woman.

en.title: Laugh, Clown, Laugh
en.overview: A despairing clown suffering a broken heart and a self-indulgent count who uncontrollably laughs learn to help each other with their problems, but both fall in love with the same young woman.
en.tagline: What did he hide behind his painted smile?

pt-BR.title: We Faw Down
pt-BR.overview: Stan e Ollie tentam enganar suas esposas indo escondidos para um jogo de pôquer, mas acabam se envolvendo com duas mulheres sedutoras, uma das quais é namorada de um boxeador ciumento.

en.title: We Faw Down
en.overview: Stan & Ollie attempt to fool their wives by sneaking out to a poker game, but instead get involved with two flirty ladies, one of whom is the girlfriend of a jealous boxer.

pt-BR.title: Wrong Again
pt-BR.overview: Stan e Ollie, dois tratadores de cavalos, estão cuidando de um puro-sangue chamado "Blue Boy". Mas, ao ouvirem dois homens conversando sobre uma recompensa de 5.000 dólares pela devolução do "Blue Boy" roubado, eles não percebem que a recompensa se refere à pintura, e não ao cavalo. Levam o cavalo até a casa do dono para receber a recompensa. O dono os instrui a colocar "Blue Boy" sobre o piano e Ollie comenta: "Esses milionários são peculiares."

en.title: Wrong Again
en.overview: Stable hands Stan and Ollie are tending a thoroughbred named "Blue Boy." But when they overhear two men talking about a $5000 reward for the return of the stolen "Blue Boy," they miss the part about it being the painting, not the horse. They take the horse to the owner's house to claim the reward. The owner instructs them to put "Blue Boy" on the piano and Ollie explains, "these millionaires are peculiar."

originalTitle: The Mystery of the Leaping Fish

pt-BR.title: The Mystery of the Leaping Fish
pt-BR.overview: Coke Ennyday, the scientific detective, divides his time into periods of "Sleep", "Eat", "Dope" and "Drinks". In fact, he overcomes every situation with drugs: consuming cocaine to increase his energy or injecting it in his opponents to incapacitate them. To help the police, he tracks down a contraband of opium (which he eagerly tastes) transported within "leaping fishes", saving a "fish-blower" girl from blackmail along the way.

en.title: The Mystery of the Leaping Fish
en.overview: Coke Ennyday, the scientific detective, divides his time into periods of "Sleep", "Eat", "Dope" and "Drinks". In fact, he overcomes every situation with drugs: consuming cocaine to increase his energy or injecting it in his opponents to incapacitate them. en.tagline: Mr Douglas Fairbanks, Sr. AS THE MASTER OF DISGUISE AND SUPER SLEUTH WITH A CLANDESTINE CRAVING "COKE" ENNYDAY

video.file: The Mystery of the Leaping Fish.mp4

pt-BR.title: High and Dizzy
pt-BR.overview: A tipsy doctor encounters his patient sleepwalking on a building ledge, high above the street.

en.title: High and Dizzy
en.overview: A tipsy doctor encounters his patient sleepwalking on a building ledge, high above the street.

pt-BR.title: A Christmas Carol
pt-BR.overview: Miser Ebenezer Scrooge is awakened on Christmas Eve by spirits who reveal to him his own miserable existence, what opportunities he wasted in his youth, his current cruelties, and the dire fate that awaits him if he does not change his ways. Scrooge is faced with his own story of growing bitterness and meanness, and must decide what his own future will hold: death or redemption.

en.title: A Christmas Carol
en.overview: Miser Ebenezer Scrooge is awakened on Christmas Eve by spirits who reveal to him his own miserable existence, what opportunities he wasted in his youth, his current cruelties, and the dire fate that awaits him if he does not change his ways. Scrooge is faced with his own story of growing bitterness and meanness, and must decide what his own future will hold: death or redemption.

pt-BR.title: Sombras
pt-BR.overview: Durante um jantar dado por um barão rico e sua esposa, quatro convidados ocupam a mesa da mansão do século 19 na Alemanha. Uma sombra dá aos convidados uma visão do que o barão ciumento pode fazer se os cavalheiros não reduzirem os olhares à sua bela esposa. O filme é considerado parte do movimento expressionista alemão.
pt-BR.tagline: Suspense expressionista de Arthur Robison.

en.title: Warning Shadows
en.overview: During a dinner given by a wealthy baron and his wife, attended by four of her suitors in a 19th century German manor, a shadow-player rescues the marriage by giving all the guests a vision what might happen tonight if the baron stays jealous and the suitors do not reduce their advances towards his beautiful wife. Or was it a vision?
en.tagline: Arthur Robison's Expressionist Thriller

pt-BR.title: The Poor Little Rich Girl
pt-BR.overview: Gwen's family is rich, but her parents ignore her and most of the servants push her around, so she is lonely and unhappy. Her father is concerned only with making money, and her mother cares only about her social position. But one day a servant's irresponsibility creates a crisis that causes everyone to rethink what is important to them.

en.title: The Poor Little Rich Girl
en.overview: Gwen's family is rich, but her parents ignore her and most of the servants push her around, so she is lonely and unhappy. Her father is concerned only with making money, and her mother cares only about her social position. But one day a servant's irresponsibility creates a crisis that causes everyone to rethink what is important to them.

pt-BR.title: The Gorilla Mystery
pt-BR.overview: A gorilla has escaped; Mickey, panicked, calls Minnie, but she plays a song to show she is not afraid. That is, until the gorilla comes up behind her and grabs her. Mickey rushes right over to save her.

en.title: The Gorilla Mystery
en.overview: A gorilla has escaped; Mickey, panicked, calls Minnie, but she plays a song to show she is not afraid. That is, until the gorilla comes up behind her and grabs her. Mickey rushes right over to save her.

pt-BR.title: The Fire Fighters
pt-BR.overview: Mickey and others are firemen; they slide down an ostrich's neck when the alarm sounds. A squealing cat whose tail Mickey pulls acts as the siren. The nearest hydrant isn't working too well, so Horace Horsecollar takes drinks from a pond and uses that water to put out the fire. Minnie is trapped on an upper floor; Mickey climbs the neighboring building fire escape and uses a clothesline to cross to Minnie's building.

en.title: The Fire Fighters
en.overview: Mickey and others are firemen; they slide down an ostrich's neck when the alarm sounds. A squealing cat whose tail Mickey pulls acts as the siren. The nearest hydrant isn't working too well, so Horace Horsecollar takes drinks from a pond and uses that water to put out the fire. Minnie is trapped on an upper floor; Mickey climbs the neighboring building fire escape and uses a clothesline to cross to Minnie's building.

pt-BR.title: Mickey's Follies
pt-BR.overview: Uma galinha e um galo apresentam uma peça teatral e Patricia Pig canta uma ópera. No fim das apresentações, vem a atração principal: Mickey canta, toca e dança a música tema dele. É dia de show no curral!

en.title: Mickey's Follies
en.overview: Mickey puts on a show in his barnyard. A short dramatic scene by a chicken and rooster; an operatic ode by Patricia Pig, and then the main attraction: Mickey sings and plays his theme song, then dances to it.

pt-BR.title: Nossa Cidade
pt-BR.overview: A mudança vem lentamente para uma pequena cidade de New Hampshire no início do século 20. As pessoas crescem, casam, vivem e morrem. Leite e jornal são entregues todas as manhãs, e ninguém trava as portas a sua frente...

en.title: Our Town
en.overview: Change comes slowly to a small New Hampshire town in the early 20th century. We see birth, life and death in this small community.
en.tagline: Their love affair was the talk of our town!

pt-BR.title: The Second 100 Years
pt-BR.overview: Laurel and Hardy are convicts making an escape from prison.

en.title: The Second 100 Years
en.overview: Laurel and Hardy are convicts making an escape from prison.
en.tagline: New starring team uncorks riotous performance in first picture as comedy duo.

pt-BR.title: A Turma da Prisão
pt-BR.overview: Mickey Mouse and several other characters are on a prison chain gang, guarded by Pegleg Pete. They break rocks for a while, then Mickey breaks out a harmonica and everyone starts making music and/or dancing. Soon there's a jail-break, and Mickey's on the run, tracked by bloodhounds (including his future pet, Pluto, in his first appearance). He falls off a cliff and right into a jail cell.

en.title: The Chain Gang
en.overview: Mickey Mouse and several other characters are on a prison chain gang, guarded by Pegleg Pete. They break rocks for a while, then Mickey breaks out a harmonica and everyone starts making music and/or dancing. Soon there's a jail-break, and Mickey's on the run, tracked by bloodhounds (including his future pet, Pluto, in his first appearance). He falls off a cliff and right into a jail cell.

pt-BR.title: Wild Waves
pt-BR.overview: Mickey Mouse is a singing lifeguard. Minnie Mouse is the damsel he must rescue before she is swept out to sea.

en.title: Wild Waves
en.overview: Mickey Mouse is a singing lifeguard. Minnie Mouse is the damsel he must rescue before she is swept out to sea.

pt-BR.title: The Blue Bird
pt-BR.overview: Peasant children Mytyl and Tyltyl are led on a magical quest for the fabulous Blue Bird of Happiness by the fairy Berylune. On their journey, they're accompanied by the anthropomorphized presences of a Dog, a Cat, Light, Fire, and Bread, among other entities.

en.title: The Blue Bird
en.overview: Peasant children Mytyl and Tyltyl are led on a magical quest for the fabulous Blue Bird of Happiness by the fairy Berylune. On their journey, they're accompanied by the anthropomorphized presences of a Dog, a Cat, Light, Fire, and Bread, among other entities.

originalTitle: La Vie et la Passion de Jésus-Christ

pt-BR.title: A Vida e a Paixão de Jesus Cristo
pt-BR.overview: A história da vida e da paixão de Jesus Cristo, desde a proclamação de seu nascimento até sua ascensão ao céu.

en.title: The Life and Passion of Jesus Christ
en.overview: The story of the life and passion of Jesus Christ, from the proclamation of his birth to his ascension into heaven.

pt-BR.title: The Barnyard Battle
pt-BR.overview: Mickey Mouse joins a mouse army to battle evil cats.

en.title: The Barnyard Battle
en.overview: Mickey Mouse joins a mouse army to battle evil cats.

pt-BR.title: Sinkin' in the Bathtub
pt-BR.overview: Sinkin' in The Bathtub foi o primeiro curta animado da Warner Bros, assim como o primeiro da série Looney Tunes. O curta foi produzido e dirigido por Hugh Harman e Rudolf Ising, com animação por um jovem Friz Freleng.

en.title: Sinkin' in the Bathtub
en.overview: The music-happy Bosko and Honey take a car ride, but bad luck briefly interrupts their fun.

pt-BR.title: Putting Pants on Philip
pt-BR.overview: Pompous J. Piedmont Mumblethunder greets his nephew from Scotland who arrives in kilts. He is immediately taken to a tailor for a pair of proper pants.

en.title: Putting Pants on Philip
en.overview: Pompous J. Piedmont Mumblethunder greets his nephew from Scotland who arrives in kilts. He is immediately taken to a tailor for a pair of proper pants.

pt-BR.title: A Thief Catcher
pt-BR.overview: Dois criminosos perseguem um policial à paisana que, ao passear com seu cachorro, testemunha o crime.

en.title: A Thief Catcher
en.overview: Two criminals chase a plainclothes policeman who, while taking out his dog, witnesses their crime.

pt-BR.title: A Patrulha da Madrugada
pt-BR.overview: Primeiro filme sonoro dirigido por Howard Hawks, The Dawn Patrol é, entre todos os filmes de aviação sobre a Primeira Guerra Mundial, o que dá uma visão mais autenticamente sombria. Algumas cenas aéreas foram filmadas pelo próprio diretor, a bordo de uma avião com a câmera fixada na parte dianteira. Segundo Ken Wlaschin, este é um dos dez melhores trabalhos no cinema dos astros Richard Barthelmess e Douglas Fairbanks Jr.. A história foi refilmada com o mesmo título em 1938, com Errol Flynn, Basil Rathbone e David Niven nos papéis principais, dirigidos por Edmund Goulding. Essa versão aproveitou tomadas aéreas fotografadas por Elmer Dyer para a produção de 1930.

en.title: The Dawn Patrol
en.overview: World War I ace Dick Courtney derides the leadership of his superior officer, but he soon is promoted to squadron commander and learns harsh lessons about sending subordinates to their deaths.
en.tagline: GREATEST AIR EPIC EVER!

pt-BR.title: Salomé
pt-BR.overview: Based on Oscar Wilde's play, the films tells the story of how Salomé agrees to dance for King Herod in return for the head of John the Baptist.

en.title: Salomé
en.overview: Based on Oscar Wilde's play, the films tells the story of how Salomé agrees to dance for King Herod in return for the head of John the Baptist.

pt-BR.title: A Dama Misteriosa
pt-BR.overview: Tania Fedorova (Garbo), uma espiã soviética no mundo pré-guerra, seduz o capitão do exército Karl Von Raden (Nigel), com intenção de furtar documentos secretos. Enquanto o austríaco Von Raden assiste à ópera, numa noite, conhece Tania. Após a performance, ele a leva para sua casa, e os dois passam o dia seguinte em um passeio romântico. Naquela noite, Karl deve entregar alguns planos importantes em Berlim. Pouco antes de embarcar no trem, ele descobre algo sobre Tania.

en.title: The Mysterious Lady
en.overview: A beautiful Russian spy seduces an Austrian military officer in order to obtain secret plans. When she falls in love with him, both are placed in danger.
en.tagline: Their net of intrigue spread through every country

pt-BR.title: A Trip to Mars
pt-BR.overview: The navy captain Avanti Planetaros is inspired by his astronomer-father to travel through outer space to reach other worlds. He becomes an aviator and, along with the young scientist Dr. Krafft, the driving force behind the construction of a space-ship. Despite oppostion from the mocking Professor Dubius, Planetaros gathers a crew of fearless men and takes off. During the long voyage, the crew becomes restless; a mutiny is narrowly avoided. Finally, they reach Mars and discover that the planet is inhabited by people who have reached a higher stage of development, free of diseases, sorrow, violence, sexual urges, and the fear of death. Avanti falls in love with Marya, daughter of the Prince of Wisdom, the head of the Martians. Marya shares his feelings and decides to return with him in order to bring the wisdom of the Martians to the backward Earthlings. (stumfilm.dk)

pt-BR.title: The Sealed Room
pt-BR.overview: A king grows suspicious of his favored woman's affection for an Italian troubadour. After confirming their secret romance, he takes a cruel revenge by sealing the lovers inside a secluded tower chamber with no means of escape.

en.title: The Sealed Room
en.overview: A king grows suspicious of his favored woman's affection for an Italian troubadour. After confirming their secret romance, he takes a cruel revenge by sealing the lovers inside a secluded tower chamber with no means of escape.

pt-BR.overview: An all-star revue featuring MGM contract players.

en.title: The Hollywood Revue of 1929
en.overview: An all-star revue featuring MGM contract players.
en.tagline: 25 of the screen's greatest stars - chorus of 200 - amazingly revolutionary motion picture!

pt-BR.title: The Golf Specialist
pt-BR.overview: At a Florida hotel, absconding miscreant J. Effingham Bellweather goes slapstick golfing with the house detective's flirtatious wife and an incompetent caddy.

en.title: The Golf Specialist
en.overview: At a Florida hotel, absconding miscreant J. Effingham Bellweather goes slapstick golfing with the house detective's flirtatious wife and an incompetent caddy.

pt-BR.title: Escravo de uma paixão
pt-BR.overview: John Schuyler (Edward José) é um diplomata casado tem a vida arruinada após ser seduzido por uma mulher predadora (Theda Bara).  Um dos pouquíssimos filmes preservados de Theda Bara, considerada a primeira grande estrela/símbolo sexual do cinema.
pt-BR.tagline: Beije-me, meu tolo!

en.title: A Fool There Was
en.overview: John Schuyler, a happily married lawyer, is appointed diplomat and sent to England. Due to an unfortunate accident, his wife and child can not come along with him. On the ship to England, Schuyler meets the notorious Vampire - a relentless gold digger who causes the moral degradation of those she seduces, first fascinating and then draining the very life from her victims.
en.tagline: Kiss me, my Fool!

pt-BR.title: Au Bonheur des Dames
pt-BR.overview: Denise, uma rapariga órfã, muda-se para Paris, onde espera encontrar trabalho na loja do seu tio. Mas a glamorosa loja de departamentos "Aux Bonheur des Dames", do outro lado da rua, está a arruinar todos os pequenos negócios da zona. Ela consegue um emprego lá.

en.title: Au Bonheur des Dames
en.overview: Denise, an orphaned girl, moves to Paris where she hopes to find work at her uncle's store. But the glamorous department store 'Aux Bonheur des Dames' across the street crushes all the little businesses around. She finds a position there.

pt-BR.title: Double Whoopee
pt-BR.overview: Stan and Ollie wreak havoc at an upper class hotel in their jobs as footman (Hardy) and doorman (Laurel). They partially undress blonde bombshell Jean Harlow (in a brief appearance) and repeatedly escort a stuffy nobleman into an empty elevator shaft.

en.title: Double Whoopee
en.overview: Stan and Ollie wreak havoc at an upper class hotel in their jobs as footman (Hardy) and doorman (Laurel). They partially undress blonde bombshell Jean Harlow (in a brief appearance) and repeatedly escort a stuffy nobleman into an empty elevator shaft.

pt-BR.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros
pt-BR.overview: O Cardeal Richelieu (Nigel De Brulier), envolvido em intrigas na corte de Louis XIII (Adolphe Menjou), ameaça a rainha (Mary MacLaren), que é secretamente apaixonado pelo Duque de Buckingham (Thomas Holding). As intenções do cardeal é uma jogada para desonrar Anne, que é Rainha da Áustria, desonrando desta forma também a própria França, e despertando a revolta de Louis XIII, impedindo, então, a união política dos dois países, e desta maneira tirar proveitos para seus próprios benefícios: conseguindo o respeito e agradecimento do rei e aumentando o seu poder palaciano. Enquanto isso, da Gasconha vem D'Artagnan (Douglas Fairbanks) aderir aos Mosqueteiros do Rei, na sua busca incansável por aventuras. Ele ganha, depois de alguns mal-entendidos, a confiança e a amizade de três dos melhores mosqueteiros do rei, Athos (Léon Bary), Porthos (George Siegmann) e Aramis (Eugene Pallete), por provar sua habilidade com a espada, sua valentia e dignidade, e juntos, fazem uma aliança eterna.

en.title: The Three Musketeers
en.overview: In 17th century France, young D'Artagnan wants to join the King's Musketeers, but instead befriends three legendary musketeers—Athos, Porthos, and Aramis—and together, they become embroiled in the political intrigue surrounding King Louis XIII and his adversaries, particularly the powerful Cardinal Richelieu.

pt-BR.title: A Fantastical Meal
pt-BR.overview: A family sits down to enjoy a meal that ends up being fraught with complications.

en.title: A Fantastical Meal
en.overview: A family sits down to enjoy a meal that ends up being fraught with complications.

pt-BR.title: A Madame com Desejos
pt-BR.overview: Sentada em um banco de um jardim público, uma menina bebe um pirulito enquanto o pai lê o jornal. Uma senhora chega esperando um feliz acontecimento, acompanhada pelo marido empurrando um carrinho de bebê ocupado pelo mais velho dos futuros irmãos. Tomada por um desejo irresistível, a senhora agarra o doce da criança que imediatamente desata a chorar para desgosto de seu pai. O cavalheiro oferece a devolução do pirulito roubado, mas o pai zangado recusa violentamente dando um tapa no cavalheiro que não pode evitar.

en.title: Madame's Cravings
en.overview: A pregnant woman steals things from others on account of her cravings.

pt-BR.overview: Duke Ellington plays hot jazz in a fictional story that finds him down on his luck; he tries in vain to dissuade his friend, dancer Fredi Washington, from working with heart trouble even though it means work for his band. Sure enough, she collapses on stage...

pt-BR.title: Stop Thief!
pt-BR.overview: A lad from a butcher shop is carrying a tray laden with a roast or a leg of lamb. A hobo grabs it and runs. The boy gives chase, joined by dogs, as neighbors watch the spectacle. The hobo jumps into a large rain barrel, followed by the dogs.

pt-BR.overview: O roubo no Hotel de Palácio Real e o sequestro de Lord Beltham, fazem de Fantômas o imperador de Crime. Cabe ao Inspetor Juve, sempre auxiliado pelo jornalista Fandor, prender o criminoso.

en.title: Fantômas
en.overview: A French silent film serial which follows the exploits of the archvillain Fantômas, who commits crimes while eluding Inspector Juve's tireless persecution.

pt-BR.title: A Ferro e Fogo
pt-BR.overview: Jovem cavaleiro finge juntar-se a gangue que matou dono de bar e raptou sua sobrinha a fim de descobrir paradeiro de fortuna escondida.

en.title: Randy Rides Alone
en.overview: Bandits lead by Matt the Mute enter a bar and kill multiple people. Randy Bowers comes to town and is framed by Matt the Mute, who is working with the sheriff (who doesn't know Matt is really a criminal). Randy escapes with the help of the niece of the dead owner of the bar. Bowers ends up running from the sheriff, and ends up in the cave in which the bandits have their hide-out…
en.tagline: Fearless--- He Rode the Danger Trail!

pt-BR.title: Os Sussurros do Morcego
pt-BR.overview: Infamous burglar "The Bat" commits a daring jewelry theft despite heavy police presence. Soon after, a bank theft occurs, which may be the work of the criminal as well. Meanwhile, Cornelia Van Gorder has various people arrive at her old mansion, including her niece, Dale, a bank employee, and police detective Anderson. When guests start turning up dead, Cornelia begins to suspect that The Bat may be lurking around the estate.

en.title: The Bat Whispers

pt-BR.overview: Homem tem como único objetivo é manter-se como o grande e renomado artista, fazendo do espetáculo um escape de vida. Quando sua ajudante vê nele um alvo fácil de sedução, planeja o assassinato do inconveniente marido. O que ela não sabe é que o despertar do amor em Flamarion pode tornar-se uma obsessão mortal.

en.title: The Great Flamarion
en.overview: A beautiful but unscrupulous female performer manipulates all the men in her life in order to achieve her aims.
en.tagline: Great with a gun!!

pt-BR.title: The Cactus Kid
pt-BR.overview: Mickey walks into the tavern where Minnie is dancing, and begins to dance and play piano himself. Pegleg Pete comes in and treats Minnie badly. Mickey tries to defend her, but Pete steals her away. Mickey, riding Horace Horsecollar, gives chase. He manages to throw Pete off a cliff.

pt-BR.overview: Buster manages the store while Roscoe delivers the mail, taking time out for hide-and-seek with Molly. The constable, also interested in Molly, steals $300 while being observed by Buster.

en.title: The Hayseed

pt-BR.title: A Desumana
pt-BR.overview: A famous singer Claire Lescot, who lives on the outskirts of Paris, is courted by many men, including a maharajah, Djorah de Nopur, and a young Swedish scientist, Einar Norsen. At her lavish parties she enjoys their amorous attentions but she remains emotionally aloof and heartlessly taunts them. When she is told that Norsen has killed himself because of her, she shows no feelings. At her next concert she is booed by an audience outraged at her coldness and she decides to visit the vault in which Norsen's body lies.

en.overview: A famous singer Claire Lescot, who lives on the outskirts of Paris, is courted by many men, including a maharajah, Djorah de Nopur, and a young Swedish scientist, Einar Norsen. At her lavish parties she enjoys their amorous attentions but she remains emotionally aloof and heartlessly taunts them. When she is told that Norsen has killed himself because of her, she shows no feelings. At her next concert she is booed by an audience outraged at her coldness and she decides to visit the vault in which Norsen's body lies.

When the husband is abandoned by his lady friend, remorse drives him to find his wife.

pt-BR.title: The Treasures of Satan
pt-BR.overview: The setting of this fantastic scene represents the hall of an old chateau in which a miser has locked up seven large bags containing his wealth. Satan, who has made his way into the chateau, puts the seven bags in a strong box, and makes with his hands some cabalistic motions. The miser comes into the hall and is greatly astonished to find his fortune missing. He opens the coffer and immediately the bags leap out. He gathers them up and puts them back into the coffer. When he opens it again he finds that they have been transformed into seven young girls, who rush out and chase after him, beating him unmercifully. They shut him up in the coffer from which his gold has vanished. The miser pushes open the lid of the coffer, and to his profound despair finds that both young girls and money have disappeared. (This view is most sensational in its mysterious scenes.) (Star Film Catalog)
